SELECT "id", "name", "code", "status", "contact_name", "email", "phone", "lead_time_days", "min_order_value", "reliability_score", "payment_terms", "country", "created_at", "updated_at", "deleted_at", count(*) OVER() AS total_count
FROM {{table:suppliers}}
WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND (coalesce("name"::text, '') ILIKE '%' || $1::text || '%' OR coalesce("code"::text, '') ILIKE '%' || $1::text || '%' OR coalesce("contact_name"::text, '') ILIKE '%' || $1::text || '%' OR coalesce("email"::text, '') ILIKE '%' || $1::text || '%')
  AND ($2::text = '' OR "status" = $2::text)
  AND (NULLIF($7::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at >= NULLIF($7::text, '')::date)
  AND (NULLIF($8::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at < (NULLIF($8::text, '')::date + interval '1 day'))
ORDER BY CASE WHEN $5::text = 'name' AND $6::text = 'asc' THEN "name" END ASC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'name' AND $6::text = 'desc' THEN "name" END DESC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'code' AND $6::text = 'asc' THEN "code" END ASC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'code' AND $6::text = 'desc' THEN "code" END DESC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'contact_name' AND $6::text = 'asc' THEN "contact_name" END ASC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'contact_name' AND $6::text = 'desc' THEN "contact_name" END DESC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'lead_time_days' AND $6::text = 'asc' THEN "lead_time_days" END ASC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'lead_time_days' AND $6::text = 'desc' THEN "lead_time_days" END DESC, id DESC
LIMIT $4::int OFFSET ((($3::int - 1) * $4::int))

SELECT "id", "name", "code", "status", "contact_name", "email", "phone", "lead_time_days", "min_order_value", "reliability_score", "payment_terms", "country", "created_at", "updated_at", "deleted_at"
FROM {{table:suppliers}}
WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND (coalesce("name"::text, '') ILIKE '%' || $1::text || '%' OR coalesce("code"::text, '') ILIKE '%' || $1::text || '%' OR coalesce("contact_name"::text, '') ILIKE '%' || $1::text || '%' OR coalesce("email"::text, '') ILIKE '%' || $1::text || '%')
  AND ($2::text = '' OR "status" = $2::text)
  AND (NULLIF($3::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at >= NULLIF($3::text, '')::date)
  AND (NULLIF($4::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at < (NULLIF($4::text, '')::date + interval '1 day'))
ORDER BY id DESC
LIMIT 5000

SELECT "id", "name", "code", "status", "contact_name", "email", "phone", "lead_time_days", "min_order_value", "reliability_score", "payment_terms", "country", "created_at", "updated_at", "deleted_at" FROM {{table:suppliers}} WHERE id = $1::int AND deleted_at IS NULL

INSERT INTO {{table:suppliers}} ("name", "code", "status", "contact_name", "email", "phone", "lead_time_days", "min_order_value", "reliability_score", "payment_terms", "country", created_at, updated_at)
VALUES ($1::text, $2::text, $3::text, $4::text, $5::text, $6::text, $7::int, $8::numeric, $9::int, $10::text, $11::text, now(), now())
RETURNING "id", "name", "code", "status", "contact_name", "email", "phone", "lead_time_days", "min_order_value", "reliability_score", "payment_terms", "country", "created_at", "updated_at", "deleted_at"

UPDATE {{table:suppliers}}
SET "name" = $2::text, "code" = $3::text, "status" = $4::text, "contact_name" = $5::text, "email" = $6::text, "phone" = $7::text, "lead_time_days" = $8::int, "min_order_value" = $9::numeric, "reliability_score" = $10::int, "payment_terms" = $11::text, "country" = $12::text, updated_at = now()
WHERE id = $1::int AND deleted_at IS NULL
RETURNING "id", "name", "code", "status", "contact_name", "email", "phone", "lead_time_days", "min_order_value", "reliability_score", "payment_terms", "country", "created_at", "updated_at", "deleted_at"
UPDATE {{table:suppliers}} SET deleted_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE id = ANY($1::int[]) AND deleted_at IS NULL RETURNING id
UPDATE {{table:suppliers}} SET deleted_at = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE id = ANY($1::int[]) AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL RETURNING id
SELECT id, "name"::text AS label FROM {{table:suppliers}} WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY "name" LIMIT 500
UPDATE {{table:suppliers}} SET "status" = $2::text, updated_at = now() WHERE id = $1::int RETURNING id, "status"
UPDATE {{table:suppliers}} SET "reliability_score" = $2::numeric, updated_at = now() WHERE id = $1::int RETURNING id, "reliability_score"
